topology: PC1 and SRV1 attach to R1 and R3. EIGRP AS100 learns the remote LAN through R2; OSPF process10 learns the same exact prefix over the direct R1–R3 link. IPv4 addressing, gateways, advertisements, passive LANs and server HTTP are prepared. Practice starts with an AD1 discard static and R1 internal EIGRP distance120.
implemented: First ENARSI lab and Layer 3 Technologies section, with accessible singular lab counts, a five-row addressing/path plan and portable practice/completed variants. ENCOR retains39 entries and seven sections; CCNA and Other remain available. Sharing retains the current domain, path and query.

Initial real client probes fail on the installed static discard route while OSPF and EIGRP adjacencies are healthy. Removing the discard exposes OSPF110 over the misconfigured EIGRP120; clearing the override restores internal EIGRP90 and real request forwarding through R2.

A fully specified static200 route to the same /24 stays configured but non-active behind both IGPs. Shutting R1 Gi0/1 withdraws EIGRP and installs OSPF110, with actual delivered client replies before the next stage.

Setting OSPF intra-area distance255 excludes the learned route from the installed RIB while the adjacency remains Full. Static200 then provides the usable forwarding path. Raising that static to255 leaves no eligible route; actual No route drops must precede repaired static200 traffic.

Removing the OSPF override restores OSPF110 before static200, and restoring Gi0/1 returns traffic to EIGRP90 via R2. Both transitions require fresh parent-linked delivered replies after the corresponding route-selection epoch.

A temporary discard host route at AD250 coexists with the installed EIGRP /24 AD90 and wins the forwarding lookup by prefix length. Actual Null route loss and fresh repaired forwarding distinguish this from same-prefix administrative source selection.

Thirteen graded tasks combine three live configuration/save checks and ten observed outcomes. Ordinary simulator notifications capture synchronous CLI outcomes even between UI frames, so closed guides do not miss quick fault/repair probes. Per-attempt epochs and incident marks require actual new packets through the intended router ports, server acceptance and matching delivered replies. Queries, stale packets, disabled services and configuration alone cannot fabricate incident completion.

The final HTTP goal requires the complete prepared page with HTTP200 over the primary path. Final health checks validate original addresses/gateways, link status, the intended protocol advertisements and passive/active interfaces, default distances, no redistribution/filter shortcuts, only the exact static backup and all three routers saved.

Practice starts0/13; the completed reference supplies three live goals without invented failure, failover or traffic achievements. All earned goals survive offline YAML export/import while RIBs, adjacencies and transient grading epochs rebuild.
scope: IPv4 IOS lab for static, internal EIGRP and intra-area OSPF administrative distances. BGP, external routes, redistribution, per-source distance rules and IPv6 are outside this exercise; this does not claim complete ENARSI exam coverage.

Existing RIB installation, longest-prefix forwarding, neighbor exchange and packet engines already implement the required behavior and are unchanged. This update adds catalog organization, topology, instructions, grading and verification.
Primary Cisco route-selection and administrative-distance references reviewed. No new live CML capture was performed; existing IOS/NX-OS CML contracts pass in the full regression suite.
No terminal styling, theme/layout, node artwork, dependencies or backend/server changes.
